transport: Canonical chrome-devtools-mcp 1.6.0; isolated headless public Chrome via JSON-RPC stdio; navigate_page and evaluate_script; no signed-in sessions
design: Bounded rigorous evidence appraisal with targeted source verification; not an exhaustive systematic review
query_notes: Default API ordering; no claim that unretrieved hits were screened.
Initial sort=RELEVANCE requests returned version-only bodies and were treated as failed queries, not zero findings. All ten discovery queries were rerun without sort.

Broad and refined queries remained noisy; exact source searches and prior-record citation tracking supplied targeted adult evidence. Multi-identifier discovery returned only one record and was not relied on for verification; each cited identifier was checked separately or by an exact-title result.
PMID 31799368 and 27479827 were excluded after metadata proved unrelated; no claims depend on them.
The stair-source erratum PMID 28222059 was discovered at metadata level; no unverified corrected quantitative result is used.
